run.method: Illustrative advisor-authored example; not a claim of model performance
limitations: Demo includes only three requirements and selected document-level assessments.
No NASA project compliance is determined from the SRS alone.

requirement_reviews.raw_text: The SFMC shall update the displayed spacecraft position at least once every 500 milliseconds while the spacecraft is in Manual Flight, Autopilot, or Combat mode.
requirement_reviews.summary: Quantified update threshold and explicit mode constraints; no quality defect identified in this limited review.

requirement_reviews.raw_text: The SFMC shall never permit the pilot to fire a weapon at a friendly spacecraft.

quality_issues.explanation: The SRS does not define which spacecraft are friendly; Open Item 10 recognizes the missing criteria. This leaves a safety inhibit difficult to verify.

srs_evidence.excerpt: Criteria for determining whether a detected spacecraft is friendly or hostile.

quality_issues.recommendation: Have mission/safety stakeholders specify classification criteria and handling of unknown status.

swe_links.explanation: The requirement documents an operator/software weapon safety inhibit, but its criteria are unresolved and comprehensive safety coverage is unverified.

srs_evidence.excerpt: The SFMC shall never permit the pilot to fire a weapon at a friendly spacecraft.

requirement_reviews.summary: Relevant safety control is recorded, but its classification rule requires stakeholder resolution.

requirement_reviews.raw_text: The pilot shall always be able to override automatic spacecraft controls.

quality_issues.explanation: The override domain and relationship to non-overridable safety inhibits are unspecified; a contradiction with REQ-015 is possible but not proven.

srs_evidence.excerpt: always be able to override automatic spacecraft controls

quality_issues.recommendation: Specify override scope and precedence for safety interlocks.

requirement_reviews.summary: Broad override rule needs safety-interface clarification.

relationships.explanation: Whether weapons safety inhibits are included in pilot-overridable automatic controls is not specified; both may be satisfiable if the inhibit is non-overridable.

srs_evidence.excerpt: never permit the pilot to fire a weapon at a friendly spacecraft
always be able to override automatic spacecraft controls

relationships.recommendation: Clarify safety inhibit precedence; do not assert a confirmed conflict from the text alone.

document_findings.explanation: No explicit qualification/verification methods are supplied for the requirements. This is a Handbook recommendation gap, not proof of NPR violation.
document_findings.recommendation: Record demonstration, test, analysis, or inspection methods or reference a companion verification matrix.

swe_coverage.rationale: At least one relevant documented safety control exists; completeness against safety/hazard analyses cannot be established.

srs_evidence.excerpt: never permit the pilot to fire a weapon at a friendly spacecraft

external_evidence_needed: Approved friend/foe criteria and safety-control precedence
